judgement.reason: The application source (api and front) lives only in git submodules that are absent from the source archive, so the Dockerfile cannot build the product from this repository.

reviews.findingEvidence: Durable local filesystem state declared: VOLUME /data (docker/Dockerfile), volume lago_redis_data:/data (docker-compose.yml redis), volume lago_storage_data:/app/storage (docker-compose.yml api), volume lago_storage_data:/app/storage (docker-compose.yml api-worker)
reviews.reason: The production Dockerfile declares VOLUME /data and installs postgresql-17 and redis-server inside the image, and the S3 setting defaults to false, so the shown lines do not prove that the app keeps no durable data on local disk.
